styleSpec: Deliberately stepped square clusters in silhouette and interior features
Bold nearly-black contour around one logical pixel in the reference
Broad flat cel shades, typically 2–3 principal tones per material, with small intentional accents
Match apparent cluster/outline density at equal displayed scale, not output PNG dimensions
Preserve each original face markers, species, costume, props, pose and appendage count/side

methodology.all43: Normalized idle-A sampling of all 43 selected motion characters. Every character inspected at 360px alpha-visible body height, with NEAREST source-only and final 3px display versions. This normalizes style comparison; it is not the game’s per-character head-based staging scale.
methodology.corrected4: All eight frames per corrected atlas visually reviewed plus alpha/crop/anchor checks. Built-in imagegen redraws, no production pixel filtering or hand-painted pixels.
methodology.runtimeRule: Verified with gallery worker: latest0162 room13_acting.rpy world 2px, interview 3px.
methodology.limits: The 3px runtime step can hide source smoothness; source-only comparison exposes remaining differences. This pass does not certify every animation frame of all unmodified atlases.

staticMotionRecommendation: Compare the enlarged head-to-body ratio against preserved static and prior motion before approving. Redraw enlarges it further, especially Yeoni/Librarian. Do not silently replace preserved static originals.
globalConclusion: 11 characters now have generated style candidates. None is production-approved. Head/body/silhouette deviations remain; Yeoni/Librarian optional and Nero crop caveat unresolved. Work stopped at user request for upload consolidation.
